title: Blueprints Configuration Schema
description: Schema for blueprints configuration. Defines component blueprints, module templates, and artifact matrices as reusable building blocks for module definitions.

component-blueprints.description: Map of blueprint name to component blueprint definition. Blueprints define WHERE components live and WHAT files they contain.

module-templates.description: Map of template name to module template definition. Templates define common module patterns that can be instantiated with the 'template' field in module definitions.

artifact-matrices.description: Map of matrix name to artifact matrix definition. Reusable artifact configurations that can be referenced by modules.

conventions.description: Discovery conventions documentation. Informational only - discovery rules come from repository.yml.

component_blueprint.description: A reusable component specification combining a component type reference with root path patterns and optional discovery rules.

component.description: Target component name in the module's Components map.

type.description: Component type (from blueprints.yml component-kinds). If empty, component name is used as the type.

root.description: Default root path pattern with {placeholder} support.

patterns.description: File pattern overrides for the component type defaults.

discovery.description: Optional filesystem-based auto-discovery. When present, the component is only created if the check passes.

component_patterns.description: File patterns for source, test, and config files.

required_file.description: Required file name for check: required_file.

set_patterns.description: When true, copies discovery patterns into the component's Patterns.Source.

derive_from.description: Component names to derive the path from.

derive_subdirs.description: Maps source component name to subdirectory suffix.

fallback_path.description: Fallback path when no derive source matches.

module_template.description: A reusable module structure with placeholders. Referenced by modules via the 'template' field.

blueprints.description: Component blueprint names to include. Resolved from the component-blueprints section.

changelog.description: Path to changelog file with {placeholder} support.

artifact_matrix.description: Artifact matrix definition. Can be a simple array of entries or an object with extends/additional.

oneOf.description: Simple matrix: array of artifact entries.
Extended matrix: inherits from another matrix and adds entries.

extends.description: Name of parent matrix to inherit entries from.

additional.description: Additional entries to add on top of parent.

artifact_entry.description: A single artifact entry in a matrix.

derive_from.description: Source artifact to derive from. Supports {placeholder} substitution.
